cases.name: an API endpoint goes to the cheap tool
cases.prompt: Fetch https://api.github.com/repos/golang/go and tell me the repository's description.

cases.name: a plain document goes to the cheap tool
cases.prompt: Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golang/go/master/README.md and tell me what it says.

cases.name: an unknown page starts cheap rather than in a browser
cases.prompt: Have a look at https://example.com and tell me what it says.

cases.name: a page already known to need scripts goes straight to the browser
cases.prompt: https://app.example.com/dashboard is a single-page app that renders entirely in JavaScript. Read it and tell me what it shows.
